tagline: 奥林巴斯数码相机，2005 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2005年推出的数码相机。配备Olympus 1:3.1-1:5.2/5,8 – 17,4 mm (35-105mm) zoom lens (5 lenses in 3 groups, 3 aspherical lenses among them)。快门速度from 1/2 sec. to 1/1000 sec.。TTL system Autofocus。

specs.传感器: 1/2.51 inch CCD with 4.0 million pixels, 80 - 320 ASA
specs.镜头: Olympus 1:3.1-1:5.2/5,8 – 17,4 mm (35-105mm) zoom lens (5 lenses in 3 groups, 3 aspherical lenses among them)
specs.闪光灯: built-in flash reaching as far as 4 meters with lens in wide-angle position
specs.英文简介: The Stylus 410 is a compact digital camera released by Japanese maker Olympus in 2005.
